description: Owner of an NFT on Celo: the wallet that holds one ERC-721 token id right now (ownerOf), plus the collection's name and symbol. Use to verify who holds an NFT before a trade, a mint gate or an airdrop; for how many a wallet holds use celo_nft_balance, for the token's metadata celo_nft_metadata. A missing contract is 404, a token that does not exist 422, both uncharged. Example: contract=0x3d79EdAaBC0EaB6F08ED885C05Fc0B014290D95A, tokenId=1. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: celo_nft_owner
title: NFT owner, Celo
